title: Hearing on mental health services for veterans and military families
summary: The City Council's Committees on Veterans and on Mental Health and Substance Use held a joint oversight hearing examining mental health and substance use services available to the roughly 122,700 veterans living in New York City and their families. Officials from the Department of Veterans' Services and the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene testified, and the hearing reviewed data showing high rates of depression, PTSD and suicidal ideation among veterans along with barriers to accessing care. The Committees also heard a resolution declaring April 7 as White Star Family Day in the city.
